description.en: Queues a smooth camera movement to a given position/reference over a number of frames, resetting the camera-control state first. Check progress with IsCamCtrlMove.
Handle of the camera being controlled.
Number of frames the movement should take.
6-element array [posX, posY, posZ, refX, refY, refZ] with the target camera position and reference point.
Optional movement/interpolation type (defaults to 0); values below 0 queue the move without applying it immediately.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.
